screen_action: Full HD window on the home page, scrolled to the top; Hold on the hero for three seconds; Slow scroll to the first section

title: Three portals, one system
screen_action: Title card with the three portal screenshots side by side: website, employee portal, admin console
visual_direction: Three cards slide in left to right; Highlight each card as it is named

title: Customer homepage
screen_action: Scroll the home page slowly from hero to footer; Hover the main navigation items; Pause on Gardens we have built and From our sites

title: Services, projects and gallery
screen_action: Open Services, then one service page: show packages and the before-and-after slider; Open Projects, filter by a category, open a project; Open Gallery, apply a filter, open a photo in the lightbox and step to the next
visual_direction: Callout on the before-and-after handle; Zoom into a gallery tile, then cut to the open lightbox

title: Shopping
screen_action: Open Shop, search and sort; Open a priced product, choose a size, Add to cart; Open the cart, change the quantity; Proceed to checkout, show the test-mode banner, pay on the test payment page; Show the order page
visual_direction: Highlight the live stock line; Callout on the test-mode banner

title: Customer account and quotations
screen_action: Open Sign in, sign in with the synthetic demo customer (email and password); Show My account: orders and quotation status; Open Get a quote and step through the form without sending; Open Messages
visual_direction: Blur the email field after typing; Step indicator callout on the quote form

title: Employee portal
screen_action: Open the employee login, sign in as the demo employee; Show the dashboard: greeting, clock card, coming-up shifts, last seven days
visual_direction: Phone-sized window (390 px) for this scene; Highlight the clock card

title: Attendance
screen_action: Press Clock in; show 'Clocked in since'; Open Attendance: month calendar and day list; Open Schedule
visual_direction: Zoom on the clock status line after the tap; Pan across the calendar

title: Employee requests
screen_action: Open Requests; Start a leave request: type, dates, reason; submit; Show a correction request for a missed time-out
visual_direction: Callout on the remaining balance

title: Admin dashboard
screen_action: Sign in to the admin console as the demo super admin; Show the dashboard panels; Open and close the sidebar groups
visual_direction: Highlight each panel in turn; Cursor highlight on the sidebar

title: Content management
screen_action: Open CMS → Services, open a service; Edit a sample sentence in the draft, save; Open Preview; Show the publishing tab and version history (do not publish on a shared environment)
visual_direction: Split screen: editor left, preview right; Callout on the version history

title: Business administration
screen_action: Open Orders, filter by status, open an order: fulfilment steps; Open Products and Inventory: adjust stock with a reason; Open Employees and Attendance: daily board, corrections queue, leave queue
visual_direction: Quick cuts between the four list pages; Zoom on the stock adjustment reason

title: Real-time updates
screen_action: Two browser windows side by side: admin Attendance (left), employee dashboard (right), two separate browser profiles; Employee presses Clock in; Admin board updates without a reload; the bell count changes
visual_direction: Split screen; Pulse highlight on the row that changes

title: Notifications
screen_action: Open the bell dropdown, then the notifications page; Show the preferences: categories, sounds, push toggle
visual_direction: Zoom on the bell badge

title: Technical architecture
screen_action: Show the overall architecture diagram from docs/architecture/diagrams.md; Show the admin System monitoring page
visual_direction: Diagram builds left to right; Cut to the System page with live health checks

title: Closing
screen_action: Return to the home page hero; Fade to the logo on white
visual_direction: Slow fade to logo; End card 4 s
